body: Please test with an official commit, `96d44363f` is not a commit in the main repo, are you using a custom build?

@AThousandShips  I am a new contributor . I  started looking at this issue and was able to repro this issue with MRP project at my local environment. I found the code which is validating the operator  **ShaderLanguage::_validate_operator** in **shader_language.cpp** which is calling **eval_operator** which causes crash as it consider it as vector. As I saw in the code we don't support Array , is this case with STRUCT too or we just need to return right ret_type as STRUCT and not bool.

Looking for guidance to fix the same
Please check [contributing](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) and you can join the [contributor chat](https://chat.godotengine.org/)

I can confirm this on 4.8.dev aac1c92f5 (Linux).
